subject: Request for availability exception & net-new throughput SLA for Astera Financial
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@asterafin.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@asterafin.com>
Date: 2027-08-29T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: SLA ask for pilot — availability + sustained throughput

Marissa — thanks again for the demo today. Astera is moving fast on the pilot and our infra team asked whether Redwood can commit to a 99.95% monthly availability and a sustained 2k reqs/minute throughput during business hours for the first 6 months.

We understand this is outside your standard SLA. The ask is driven by internal audit and our trading desk requirements. They also want a fallback plan if there's a regional outage. Can you confirm feasibility and high-level pricing impact?

I've attached a short doc outlining the expected traffic patterns and retention constraints. Happy to jump on a call if easier.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Director, Platform Engineering
Astera Financial

Attachment: Astera_SLA_Request_20270829.pdf
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@asterafin.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@asterafin.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-29T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SLA ask for pilot — availability + sustained throughput

Daniel — appreciate the clear ask and the traffic sample. Quick notes from my side: we can discuss a bespoke availability commitment, but there are three cross-functional checks required before we can commit:

- Product/Runtime feasibility (Karthik): confirm sustained 2k reqs/min P95/P99 behavior, burst handling, and whether a dedicated pool is needed.
- Ops / Capacity (Lauren): estimate reserved GPU footprint and runbook changes for weekend ops and paging.
- Commercial (me + finance): sketch pricing uplift and any credit mechanics for SLA breaches.

Karthik — can you run a quick feasibility check (simulated load or model profile) and flag whether this requires dedicated capacity or just capacity reservations + routing tweaks? If dedicated GPUs are needed we should document expected baseline cost.

Lauren — if we proceed, Astera wants a fallback plan for region failure (automatic reroute to secondary region + KV cache warmup). What needs to be added to the runbook to support a 99.95% guarantee?

Daniel / Priya — I'll get back with an internal recommendation by EOD Tuesday (9/1). If you can share expected peak window PST hours that would help sizing.

—Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: --
Date: 2027-08-30T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SLA ask for pilot — availability + sustained throughput

Marissa — quick feasibility note after a 2-hour sim run:

- Sustained 2k reqs/min is achievable with a small dedicated pool (estimated 8 x A100-ish equivalent for our current LLM config) given the models Astera plans to use.
- P95 latency looks fine; P99 requires KV cache tuning and persistent warm pools to reduce cold starts.
- Cross-region failover is doable but will add ~12–18s during cache warmup unless we pre-warm KV caches in the failover region (which has an ops cost).
- Autoscaling alone (shared hosted capacity) is brittle for a contractual SLA of 99.95 — I'd recommend dedicated capacity with routing and a pre-warm strategy.

Estimate: dedicated pool + pre-warm runbook + 4hr ops on-call coverage will be the minimal path to reach the availability target. I'll draft a short runbook and a capacity estimate by EOD Monday.

Karthik
Senior Product Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-31T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SLA ask for pilot — availability + sustained throughput

Adding ops perspective:

- Runbook changes required:
  * Persistent warm pool in primary and standby regions (automation to keep KV cache replica updated every 10 minutes)
  * Scheduled pre-warm windows before expected peak (we'll need a 30–60 minute lead from Astera)
  * Enhanced paging for on-call (extra rotation week for first 90 days of the contract)
- Staffing & cost impact: estimate 1.4 FTE-equivalent (ops runbook + pre-warm automation + monitoring dashboards) scaled to the dedicated pool size.
- Failure SLA mechanics: recommend a rolling credit model tied to per-minute downtime >5 minutes, with a max cap tied to monthly committed spend.

Evelyn — finance will need approval for the credit structure and we may need a one-time onboarding credit. Can you advise?

Lauren
Head of Site Reliability
From: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@asterafin.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SLA ask for pilot — availability + sustained throughput

Thanks everyone — summary and recommendation:

- Decision: Approve a bespoke 99.95% monthly availability SLA for Astera Financial for an initial 6-month pilot on the condition they take Dedicated capacity (8 GPU-equivalent pool) + sign the runbook addendum.
- Commercials: 35% uplift on standard Dedicated pricing + a one-time onboarding fee. Downtime credit: prorated per-minute after 5 continuous minutes, capped at 15% of monthly committed spend.
- Obligations from Astera: provide 30–60 minute peak window notice, participate in 1 pre-warm ops drill, and agree to a 3-week ramp clause where credits are reduced to 50% for the initial ramp period.

Next steps (owners & deadlines):
- Karthik: finalize runbook + capacity numbers (EOD 9/3).
- Lauren: create monitoring & paging playbook draft (EOD 9/3).
- Marissa: share commercial term sheet and DocuSign link to Daniel (by 9/2).
- Evelyn (Finance): draft credit language for SOW and confirm the pricing uplift (by 9/2).

Marissa — once we have Karthik and Lauren artifacts, I'll sign off and Marissa can finalize the customer-facing SOW.

Evelyn Hart
VP, Finance & Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
